title: Write rustdoc module-level documentation for all public API
description:
Add module-level //! doc comments to every public module in usenet-ipfs-core: lib.rs, article.rs, canonical.rs, group_log/mod.rs, group_log/types.rs, signing.rs, validation.rs. Each module doc: what it does, when to use it, example usage. Artifact: inline docs in each file.

Acceptance criteria: cargo doc -p usenet-ipfs-core --no-deps produces complete HTML with no missing doc warnings; every public type and function has a doc comment
